svg.title: Figure 2. Runtime accountability: presentation is not execution
svg.desc: One canonical mission intent is anchored to one Story-owned run-scoped authorized invocation A, with independently frozen expected execution count of one. A source-projected raw Space Packet representation B(A) is associated with A, not generated from A. P1 presents B(A) to an external FlatSat; native observations pass a strict occurrence-acceptance criterion. Only if E1 is accepted may a second presentation P2 of the exact same bytes occur. Target-owned observations are retained, and the Story reconciles expected count with evidence-supported observed execution count using four possible semantic outcomes. All physical FlatSat executions remain not run.
svg.text: Figure 2. Runtime accountability: presentation is not execution
B(A) — frozen raw SPP target stimulus
Same exact bytes for P1 and conditional P2
Associated with A; NOT generated from A
Only after valid control / identity preflight
P2 — second presentation of same B(A)
Retain exact bytes within bounded window
New raw STATUS evidence; sequence / uptime
Retained native observations + presentation / occurrence records + run validity
Presentation ≠ execution. Reconcile only evidence-supported occurrences.
CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT MODEL — PHYSICAL FLATSAT: NOT RUN
